# Form Control

See [Input fields guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/input-field/design/)

The `ds-formcontrol` class provides a generic wrapper for form controls (`ds-formcontrol-control`).

<Canvas of={FormcontrolStories.Basic} />

In addition to a label (`ds-formcontrol-label`), these optional elements can be used :

- optional state (`ds-formcontrol-optional`)
- help text (`ds-formcontrol-help`)
- help link (`ds-formcontrol-helplink`)

See <LinkTo kind="General/Forms/Examples" story="docs">Forms</LinkTo> to see a full form example.

## States

`ds-formcontrol--success` and `ds-formcontrol--error` modifier classes are there for styling form control validation states.

<Canvas>
  <Story of={FormcontrolStories.States} />
</Canvas>

## Optional

Optional form controls should be highlighted with the `ds-formcontrol-optional` class

<Canvas of={FormcontrolStories.Optional} />

## Help

Guidance on how to fill the form, or feedback messages can be displayed with the `ds-formcontrol-help` class.<br />
In addition to a message, you can provide a link.

<Canvas of={FormcontrolStories.Help} />

## Info

An Icon Button can be used to provide additional infos.

<Canvas of={FormcontrolStories.Info} />
